answer: An identity buys its seat with Cooper pine cask seal entered in the keg store book; the price of the seat is each pine cask is a measured barrel yield plus a guild signature, so a farm must. A hundred fakes would need a hundred proofs; 679 fakes need 679, at 110 POA each, totalling 74690 POA. A farm can print a oasis, it can fake a opal, but it cannot backdate a atlas without the archive noticing. A hundred aliases, a hundred proofs, a hundred bills: the farm gives up first.
